meta.name: Smoke
meta.description: When an arson investigator begrudgingly teams up with a police detective, their race to stop two arsonists ignites a twisted game of secrets and suspicions.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Tensions rise as the search for suspects begins. Michelle Calderone pumps the brakes on her personal life. Dave Gudsen gets creative.

videos.title: Your Happy Makes Me Sad
videos.overview: Seemingly stalled, Gudsen and Calderone consider a new lead. Chaos ensues on a side mission. Freddy Fasano rethinks his future.

videos.title: Weird Milk
videos.overview: Calderone charts her own course for answers. Gudsen pitches a new path for their partnership. Freddy heads to Coop's headquarters.

videos.title: Strawberry
videos.overview: Gudsen sheds light on his dark past. Calderone digs even deeper. Freddy starts to spiral.

videos.title: Size Matters
videos.overview: While Gudsen heads out of town for a conference, Calderone tries to track down his old partner. Freddy seeks revenge.

videos.title: Manhood
videos.overview: Esposito and Calderone urge Harvey to take action. A fully rogue Freddy reaches out to an ally.

videos.title: Whitewashed Tombs
videos.overview: On the heels of heartache, Calderone clocks in for a covert mission. Gudsen navigates newfound glory—and an unexpected confrontation.

videos.title: Mercy
videos.overview: Gudsen flips the script. Harvey grapples with regret. Calderone is forced to confront her past.

videos.title: Mirror Mirror
videos.overview: A desperate Calderone calls in a favor. Gudsen scrambles for control. A massive blaze stokes a make-or-break showdown.
